name: depop-mcp
description: Depop (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool

platform_mcp_depop_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DEPOP_API_KEY
platform_mcp_depop_api_key.description: Depop Partner API key (issued by Depop to approved enterprise partners; API-key tokens carry every scope); sent as Authorization: Bearer.

tools.name: me
tools.description: getSellerDetails: {id, username, country_code} of your Depop shop.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: patchProduct PATCH /api/v1/products/by-sku/{sku}/ {price_amount, quantity} changes the LIVE price (a decimal string in the listing's currency) and/or quantity of an ON SALE product; `listing_id` is your SKU. Title/description changes need the full PUT (all product fields) and are not done here.

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: patchProduct {quantity} sets the quantity of an ON SALE product by SKU (`sku` required). Restocking a sold-out product requires the full PUT createOrUpdateProduct, which this tool does not send.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: deleteProduct DELETE /api/v1/products/by-sku/{sku}/ DELETES the listing from Depop; `listing_id` is your SKU.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: getAllOrders ?limit(max 200)&from(ISO date-time): {meta: {cursor, has_more}, data: [{purchase_id, status (SHIPPING_PENDING|SHIPPED|REFUNDED|CANCELLED|COMPLETED), currency, buyer_pays_amount, seller_receives_amount, line_items[{parcel_id...}]}]}. No status filter; pagination is by meta.cursor, so only the first page is returned. Amounts are decimal strings.
